examples.problem:
What are the dimensions of the matrix ${D},$ where 

$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$
examples.worked_solution: The matrix ${D}$ has $1$ row and $4$ columns. So, its dimensions are $1\times 4.$

feedback.worked_solution: The matrix $S$ has $6$ rows and $6$ columns. Therefore, its dimensions are $6\times 6.$
